name: B10-0489/2026 (S&D) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns repeated missile and drone attacks by the Houthis, an armed group in Yemen backed by Iran, on Saudi Arabia. It calls for the Houthis to be added to the EU's terrorist list, with safeguards so aid can still reach Yemeni civilians. It also wants the EU's naval mission in the Red Sea expanded, more sanctions on Iran, and a full EU strategy for the Middle East. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to list the Houthis as terrorists and freeze their funds.
- EU naval patrols in the Red Sea should get more ships and aircraft.
- The EU should present a Middle East strategy and assess the economic damage.
